name: pciconfig_iobase
synopsis: int pciconfig_iobase(int which, unsigned long bus, unsigned long devfn);
description: pciconfig_iobase retrieves the physical address of various I/O regions for a specified PCI bus and device/function pair. It takes a 'which' parameter to indicate the type of region, such as memory offset or IO base.

parameters.name: which
parameters.description: Specifies the type of I/O base to retrieve (e.g., IOBASE_BRIDGE_NUMBER, IOBASE_MEMORY, IOBASE_IO, IOBASE_ISA_IO, IOBASE_ISA_MEM)

return_value.success: Returns the physical address of the specified I/O region
return_value.failure: Returns -1 and sets errno to indicate the error
